newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lojas estimates lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lojas estimates lowered.

text.p: -- Bear, Stearns & Co said it lowered its 1996 and 1997 earnings forecasts for Brazilian retailer Lojas Americanas.
-- The brokerage cut its 1996 forecast to break-even from $0.50 per level one American Depositary Receipt, and cut its 1997 projection to $0.70 per ADR from $0.90.

-- Bear Stearns cited Lojas Americanas's worse-than-expected third-quarter loss, which it blamed on continued losses from bad credit, large losses in its joint-venture with WalMart do Brasil, and a decline in sales from the previous quarter.

-- The brokerage did not give a rating on the firm's shares but said, "There exists better options in Brazil's retail sector and (we) would not recommend purchase of Lojas Americanas until solid evidence of improved credit controls and a turnaround in the WalMart joint venture are evident."
-- Lojas Americanas preferred stock was unchanged from Friday's close at 14.10 reais, while its votiong common was untraded at 13.50 reais at 1113 local/1313 GMT on the Sao Paulo stock exchange.
